selected_branches.branch: Stopping or standing within an intersection

law_text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Within an intersection.
